name: ContactLint
description: Local stdio MCP server and bridge for ContactLint contact validation. validate_email and validate_emails (up to 50 addresses) check RFC syntax, MX and A records via DNS-over-HTTPS, disposable domains, role addresses, free providers, and domain typos without SMTP probing. validate_phone parses phone numbers and returns valid/possible flags, line type, region, and E.164 format. Reads CONTACTLINT_API_KEY from the environment and forwards authenticated calls to https://contactlint.com/mcp (100 free checks per month, no card required).
author: ContactLint

CONTACTLINT_API_KEY.description: ContactLint API key sent as the Authorization Bearer token for validation tool calls. Get a free key (100 checks/month, no card) at https://contactlint.com/signup
